Subject: PO timing & invoice dependencies for booking recognition

Hi Bethany —

Quick follow-up on the procurement side so Finance can line up booking recognition for the quarter. Two quick clarifying questions from our end: 

1) Do you expect the signed PO to be issued before your internal vendor onboarding is complete, or will onboarding and vendor set-up be the gating item for us to invoice?
2) Are invoices for Redwood services processed on receipt of PO or on delivery/milestone (SOW acceptance)? If it's net terms, please confirm which day the 30/45 starts (PO receipt vs. go-live).

We want to avoid any surprises in the March close — if the PO will arrive after vendor onboarding we may need to push the booking into April unless the procurement team confirms an exception. 

Cc'ing our finance and revops leads to make sure we have everything they need on file. If easier, we can hop on a quick 15-min call today.

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the note. Short answers below: 

1) We will approve the PO in procurement before final vendor onboarding but the vendor setup ticket (our IT security checks) typically completes ~5 business days after PO issuance. Procurement can issue the PO this week once I get a final billing address.

2) Our policy is to start net terms on receipt of a validated PO (we process invoices on receipt). However, our AR team will not cut payment until vendor onboarding is complete if there are outstanding security dependencies. In practice that means: PO received = invoice accepted into the system, payments start net30 from PO receipt only if onboarding is complete within the net period.

I'll loop in procurement and a contact from AR for clarity.

Bethany Ortiz
Director, Vendor Programs | Acme Health
bethany.ortiz@acmehealth.com | +1 203-555-0114

Marissa / team —

Thanks for flagging. A few notes from Finance that we'll need to be explicit about to book revenue in March: 

• We can recognize the booking in March if we have an approved PO in our possession and (1) SOW is signed and (2) vendor onboarding is confirmed or explicitly waived by Acme AR. If onboarding is still pending and AR ties payment to onboarding completion, we cannot recognize the booking until the payment terms are effectively actionable.

• Required artifacts: Signed PO (PDF), Signed SOW (DocuSign confirmation), Billing contact + remit address, and internal acceptance criteria (if milestone-based).

• If procurement issues a PO this week but onboarding is expected to finish after month-end, we should set expected booking recognition to the first business day after onboarding completes. For forecast hygiene, please mark stage as Commit -> Pending PO in the CRM and add a close note indicating "PO issued; onboarding pending — booking recognition delayed pending vendor setup."

Rishi, can you add the PO requirement as a mandatory checklist item on the HubSpot deal so that AEs don't mark Closed-Won without the artifacts?

- Stephanie

Two quick next steps to keep the forecast clean:

2) Bethany / AR: if onboarding cannot be completed before 03/31, can procurement please confirm an exception to allow payment processing on PO receipt? If not, we'll mark the deal as Closed-Won -> Recognize on onboarding completion and update the close date in HubSpot so March forecast isn't overstated.

Cc'ing Vivek and Rishi — Vivek, want to flag that if onboarding slips past month-end we should not show this as committed for March; Rishi, can you update the deal stage per Stephanie's checklist if we receive the PO without onboarding complete?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to jump on a 10-min call to unblock.
